achievements.name: A New Beginning
achievements.description: The journey has begun. The world is waiting.

achievements.name: Two faces
achievements.description: You met Januarius and Jully. However, it seems like they're the same person.

achievements.name: A Man of Many Talents
achievements.description: Jack has found his way to the town.

achievements.name: A Little Magic
achievements.description: The fairy has answered the call.

achievements.name: First Blood
achievements.description: You won your first battle.

achievements.name: Words of Faith
achievements.description: You delivered your first sermon.

achievements.name: The Man Behind the Curtain
achievements.description: Gunter has entered the story.

achievements.name: Back to Life
achievements.description: The town has taken its first steps toward recovery.

achievements.name: Open for Business
achievements.description: You completed your first town order.

achievements.name: A New Dawn
achievements.description: The South part of Town has been cleared of zombies.

achievements.name: Friends in Low Places
achievements.description: You met the bandits.

achievements.name: A Night to Remember
achievements.description: You attended Linda's concert.

achievements.name: Forbidden Knowledge
achievements.description: You found the Necronomicon. Some books should stay buried.

achievements.name: The People Have Spoken
achievements.description: The elections are over. The future has been decided.

achievements.name: The End of the Journey
achievements.description: You completed the game.

achievements.name: Tree Bane
achievements.description: You've felled 100 trees! The whole forest fears you now.

achievements.name: True Graveyard Keeper
achievements.description: You've buried 50 corpses! Now you are The True Graveyard Keeper!

achievements.name: Patron of merchants
achievements.description: You built all the market stalls in the Town.

achievements.name: Urban Planner
achievements.description: You've restored all the houses in the Town. It's never looked so good!

achievements.name: Home Sweet Tomb
achievements.description: The quality of your cemetery has reached 200. Rest in style.

achievements.name: Bronze Age
achievements.description: You've smelted 100 bronze ingots.

achievements.name: Iron Age
achievements.description: You've smelted 100 iron ingots. Why so much?

achievements.name: Supplier
achievements.description: You've created 50 supplies. The town is depending on you.

achievements.name: Merchants' Best Friend
achievements.description: You've completed 25 merchant orders.

achievements.name: Warmaker
achievements.description: You've crafted 50 battle items. What a time to live!

achievements.name: Master Cook
achievements.description: You've cooked 100 dishes! You won't be starving.

achievements.name: Necromancer
achievements.description: You've resurrected 50 zombies. A whole army!

achievements.name: Master Farmer
achievements.description: You've harvested 100 crops. Enough for the whole Town!

achievements.name: Alcohol Baron
achievements.description: You have produced 100 bottles of alcohol... Handle with care.

achievements.name: Shepherd of Souls
achievements.description: You've preached 50 sermons! A true shepherd of wayward souls.

achievements.name: Stroke of Genius
achievements.description: You've had 150 Inspirations. Your mind is sparkling.

achievements.name: Novice Alchemist
achievements.description: You've brewed 25 potions. The eyebrows will grow back.

achievements.name: Fish Magnet
achievements.description: You caught 50 fish, so now they've put a bounty on your head.
